title: Crispy halloumi with tomatoes and white beans

source.title: Crispy Halloumi With Tomatoes and White Beans

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp chopped, plus more to serve

ingredients.name: Cannellini beans
ingredients.amount: 1 × 400g tin, or butter or navy beans

instructions: Set the grill to high with a rack in the upper third of the oven, 8 to 10cm from the heat. Halve the tomatoes lengthways, mince the garlic, chop the parsley, drain the beans and slice the halloumi ½cm thick.

In a large ovenproof pan over a medium heat, combine 2 tbsp olive oil with the tomatoes, garlic, parsley, honey and oregano. Season and cook, stirring often, for about 10 minutes, until the tomatoes soften and release their juices.
Stir in the beans and cook for about 3 minutes, until heated through. Taste, season, and turn off the heat.
Lay the halloumi slices over the top and grill for about 5 minutes, until golden and crisp.
Drizzle generously with olive oil, squeeze over the lemon, add a light drizzle of honey and a scatter of parsley. Serve at once, with bread.
